summary: Looks at data flows in low-power and lossy networks that use RPL for routing, and lists the cases that require the RPL Packet Information option, the source routing header, and IPv6-in-IPv6 encapsulation. It aims to clarify when each is needed in the data plane.

eli5.summary: In networks of tiny sensors, packets sometimes need extra labels or wrapping. This explains exactly when and why.

questions: when is rpl rpi option required
